name: Frostmane Hold
summary: Frostmane trolls hold the cliffs south of Gnomeregan in western Dun Morogh. The Ironforge Guard watches their camp and caverns as raiders press into dwarven lands.

sections.title: A Troll Bastion in the Snows
sections.body: Frostmane Hold cuts into the cold cliffs of western Dun Morogh. Rough structures stand outside its winding caves, where hideskinners and headhunters guard the tribe's stronghold. Frostmane raiders leave from here to strike the valleys, threaten travelers on the mountain passes, and test the defenses around Kharanos.

sections.title: A Thorn in Kharanos' Side
sections.body: Dwarven commanders in Kharanos fear the Frostmane buildup. Young mountaineers and adventurers scout the caverns, map their defenses, and thin the warbands before the tribe can gather for an organized assault on dwarven outposts.

faq.answer: Frostmane ice trolls live in the hold, including hunters, hideskinners, headhunters, chieftains, and raiders.
Frostmane Hold lies in western Dun Morogh, south of Gnomeregan's industrial ruins and west of Kharanos.

faq.q: Why are the dwarves interested in this cave?
faq.answer: Dwarven leaders in Kharanos fear the Frostmane are gathering enough strength to raid settlements. They send scouts to map the caves and thin the trolls' ranks.

faq.q: Are there troggs in Frostmane Hold?
faq.answer: No. Frostmane ice trolls occupy the hold. Troggs in Dun Morogh remain mainly in their own dens and the ruins of Gnomeregan.

angles.text: The Frostmane have contested Dun Morogh for centuries. For mountaineers, clearing Frostmane Hold is a rite of passage in the effort to protect Ironforge's snowy heartland.
South of Gnomeregan, Frostmane Hold is another dangerous hostile front beside the embattled former gnome capital.
